limitations: Deterministic transient-fault injection (first *attempts_to_fail* attempts of a faulted logical call fail), not observed production failures; the injection rate and epoch length are experimental parameters, not measured values.
Single model (deepseek-v4-flash) by decision; repeat seeds vary the injected fault surface only, they do not re-sample model behaviour.
The budget sweep uses per-task budgets calibrated from one fault-free run per task; the calibrated turn requirement is itself a point estimate (no repeat of calibration).

Task-pool provenance: V1 artifact = 20 tasks (commit 02ac71a), V2 artifact = 32 tasks (commit 43c4e89), V3 artifact = 31 tasks with drift-hardened ground truth (HN karma replaced by immutable account-creation year, commit 8ad347e). This runner now produces the V3 task-pool artifact; older artifacts are reproduced from their commits.

Ground truth is built once before the whole eval (single model, ~30 min run); weather/FX are live values and drift slightly, absorbed by the verifier tolerances. The V3 pool has no live-mutable HN karma tasks.
Failure-mode classification ('format_miss' vs 'no_expected_value') is a heuristic over the expected scalars, not an LLM judgement.
Free public APIs are not production grade; API drift can affect reruns, and the GitHub API is excluded because of the key-free rate limit.
